2: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. May the Lord answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,
3: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,
4: remember all your offerings, and accept your burnt sacrifice. Selah.
5: May He grant you your heart's desire, and fulfill all your counsel.
6: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the Lord grant all your requests.
7: Now I know that the Lord saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.
8: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust the name of the Lord our God.
9: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.
10: Save, Lord! Let the King answer us when we call!
